entities.summary: Bruno Ahrends (1878–1948), born as Bruno Arons, was an internationally known German architect, who worked in Berlin, Germany. He was a representative of Berlin Modernism Housing Estates before World War I and during Weimar Republic. Most of his creations today are under Cultural heritage management, some are part of a World Heritage Site.
